description: Fork of dotnet/dotnet-monitor: only the maestra sidecar image is ours. Pin its MCR bases by digest so an MCR rebuild (servicing, base CVEs) opens a PR whose merge rebuilds dotnet-monitor-maestra via sidecar-image.yml; DirectCRM then picks up the new digest through the org preset. The Mend app skips forks without forkProcessing.

packageRules.description: Stay on the .NET 10 line: the extension targets net10.0 and the fork tracks release/10.0.
No automerge: an external digest move is new content and waits for a human (issues-maestra#1649).
